background_inquiry.scope: Keep explicit consent, then run without blocking other page operations. Share one request/confirmation lock across full page and floating view.
fixes: Preserve immutable per-confirmation history snapshot; confirmation holds its prepare lock until dismissal or atomic execute transition
Close confirmation immediately on execution; late completion updates shared conversation without redirecting a different route/query
Use account epoch and shared read revision to reject stale GET/PATCH/prepare/execute callbacks
Unmount old floating client on public routes, remount local state by epoch and clear shared state on sign-out
Retry URL-directed history reads after the shared request finishes; explicit new conversation and typing invalidate previous reads
background_inquiry.tests: Three store tests plus controlled browser scenarios added. Browser completion pending.
background_inquiry.review: Independent read-only review found asynchronous privacy/ordering issues; root applied fixes and added regression scenarios. Browser evidence is required before acceptance.
